artworks.title: Zwei Menschen (Two Nudes)
artworks.medium: drypoint in brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two nude individuals, a woman and a man. The woman is reclining on her side, with her left arm above her head leaning against the man's shoulder. The man is seated upright with his left arm on his knee. Both figures have sketched facial features and no visible clothing or jewelry. They are on a simple surface with a plain background.

artworks.title: Gattin des Künstlers (Wife of the Artist)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body sketch of a person seated, with their head resting in their hand, and their fingers gently touching their chin and cheek. The person is positioned slightly sideways to the viewer. They have short, neatly combed hair with a center parting. The facial features are prominently sketched, highlighting wide eyes and a thoughtful expression. The person is wearing a loose, long-sleeved blouse with a neckline detail. The background is a simple line drawing, depicting a room with sparse details, including what appears to be picture frames or windows on the wall. The predominant medium used in the sketch is a series of fine lines.

artworks.title: Kühe (Cows)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of cows from a slightly elevated point of view. There is no distinct horizon line. The background is simple, and the cows are sketched with loose and quick strokes. The cows are shown in different positions, some standing and some lying down, with one facing the viewer. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, grey, and off-white.

artworks.title: Frauenkopf (Head of Woman)
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait sketch of an individual displaying their head and shoulders. The subject appears in a thoughtful pose, with a slightly tilted head and a hand resting on the chin. The person's facial features are emphasized, particularly the eyes and lips, and they have dark, somewhat tousled short hair. The clothing is minimal, possibly a light, patterned material, with a visible collar. The background is plain. The artwork includes the artist's signature at the bottom, "Corinth," in red ink.

artworks.title: Mutter und Kind (Mother and Child)
artworks.medium: softground etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a woman and a child. The woman is in profile, holding the child. The woman has her hair in a bun and the child has loose hair with a ribbon. Both figures are dressed in textured clothing, and the woman is seated on a chair. In the background, there is a large circular object on furniture and a window or framed shape above it. The setting is an interior room depicted in a sketch-like style.

artworks.title: Lesendes Mädchen (Girl Reading)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman from the waist up in a seated position, with her legs extended to her right. She holds an open book in her left hand at eye level. She has medium-length, wavy dark hair and facial features are subtly sketched. She is wearing a dress with short sleeves and there is an indication of a pattern on the fabric, along with a belt at her waist. The sketch is primarily created with charcoal or pencil on a textured paper background, with expressive, rapid strokes that suggest the background without detailing it extensively.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis (Self-Portrait)
artworks.medium: softground etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body. The person is seated, leaning slightly forward with their hands on the table. The facial features are ruggedly drawn with bold lines for the eyes, nose, and mouth. The person has short, dark hair and wears a loose-fitting top with long sleeves. The background is roughly sketched, suggesting an indoor setting. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands.

artworks.title: Liegender Weiblicher Akt I (Reclining Female Nude I)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person lying down in a reclined position with legs apart and arms above their head. The facial features are loosely sketched, with closed eyes and the head turned slightly to one side. The person has short, dark hair combed back and is depicted nude. The background is minimal, with a plain, light-colored surface. The style is simple and sketch-like, with shading to define the person's form.

artworks.title: Liegender Weiblicher Akt II (Reclining Female Nude II )
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a nude person lying on their back on a flat surface. The person's right leg is bent at the knee and their left leg is extended. Their right arm is resting above their head, while their left arm is at their side. The individual has long hair, a side profile with a relaxed expression, and a smaller sketch of a face is shown in the upper right corner. The background is plain, and the artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Stierkopf (Head of a Steer)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cow's head resting against something. The drawing depicts the cow's face, emphasizing its facial features and textured fur. The technique used highlights the fur's curls and layers, with shading used to create depth and dimension, particularly around the eyes and nose. The cow's horns and ears are visible, enhancing the sense of realism. The drawing shows the cow in a calm resting position.

artworks.title: Kälber (Calves)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a field scene with young animals near wooden posts or fencing. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, with sloping lines in the background suggesting a horizon. The sketch-like style features loose pencil strokes capturing movement with minimal detail. The monochromatic color palette consists of dark hues on a light beige background. The scene includes animals, wooden structures, and undefined elements in the distance for depth.

artworks.title: Auf dem Lande (In the Country)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The sketch depicts three individuals. The first person is sitting upright with their legs stretched out, the second person is reclining next to a smaller figure lying on the ground. The facial features of all three individuals are softly defined with subtle expressions. The first person appears to have short hair, possibly wearing a hat. The adult lying down has their hair pulled back, and the child's hair frames their face. They are wearing simple, modest clothing. The child is in a short-sleeved dress. No jewelry is visible, and there are no objects being held. An indistinct oval shape is near them. The background features abstract, flowing lines suggesting gentle contours of landscapes or clouds. The image is done in a light, sketchy style with broad, sweeping strokes.

artworks.title: Schafböcke (Rams)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on J. W. Zanders laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two rams. The drawing is executed in a loose, sketchy manner using pencil or charcoal on paper. The lines are fluid and expressive, capturing the essence of the rams with minimal detail. The two rams are positioned side by side.

artworks.title: Schlafende (Sleeping Woman)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude person lying on a cushioned surface. The person is shown reclining on their back, with one arm resting on their chest and the other extended beside them. They have one leg slightly bent and the other stretched out. The person's face is drawn with closed eyes and dark hair falling behind them. The surroundings include loosely draped fabric or bedding, with minimal detail. The background is plain, focusing on the figure and bedding, which are outlined with fine lines in a monochromatic style.

artworks.title: Obstgarten im Herbst (Fruit Garden in Autumn)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The sketch features twisted trees, a fenced area, scattered chickens, and a shed. The ground-level view shows the trees extending into the distance with an indistinct horizon obscured by the trees. Loose brushstrokes suggest forms in sepia tones and black, giving the image an aged look.

artworks.title: Frau mit Handarbeit (Woman with Needlework)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman seated in a relaxed posture. She is holding an infant in her arms. The woman has defined facial features with dark hair styled away from her face. She is wearing loose-fitting clothing and her arms are positioned securely around the child. The background consists of vertical line patterns.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis im Pelz (Self-Portrait in a Fur Coat)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a line drawing of a man seated with his upper body facing slightly to the right. He has expressive facial features, including a mustache, bushy eyebrows, and short hair. He appears to be wearing a loose garment, with one hand holding a pen or pencil. The background is abstract, suggesting an interior space.

artworks.title: Thomas Corinth
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a young child seated on a chair. The child is looking directly at the viewer with a simple expression. They wear a hat and a double-breasted coat. The background is plain, and the sketch is signed in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Liegender Weiblicher Akt III (Reclining Female Nude III )
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is of a person lying on their back on a horizontal surface. One arm is bent across their forehead, and the other arm is extended to the side. One leg is bent with the foot resting on the surface, while the other leg is extended. The person appears unclothed with shaded body contours, subtly defined facial features, and long hair resting behind the head. The background is minimally depicted with simple, shaded lines.

artworks.title: Weiblicher Akt in Abwehr (Female Nude Defending Herself)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image is a monochromatic illustration of a person's upper body from the waist up. The individual is in a dynamic pose with one arm raised over the head and the other arm extended slightly downwards. The head is tilted back with an upward gaze, and the facial features, including the open mouth and closed eyes, are highlighted. The person has short dark hair and is depicted without clothing, wearing a necklace with large beads. The background is plain with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Bacchanal
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures in a pastoral scene. The scene depicts an idyllic field filled with flowers and a group of mythological creatures and figures. The figures are artistically intertwined with the natural surroundings. Above the field, the sky is lightly sketched with clouds. The lines are simplistic yet expressive, focusing on the fluid motion and interaction of figures within a landscape.

artworks.title: Weissagung (Prophecy)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. One person is reclining on their back with their head resting on the lap of the person seated behind them. The reclining individual has short hair and a calm expression. The seated person is partially clothed and has short, dark hair, appearing to look towards the reclining person. No objects are depicted with either individual. The background consists of minimalistic outlines hinting at an indoor setting with drapery or curtains. The style of the artwork is sketch-like, emphasizing the figures' contours and forms.

artworks.title: Selbstbildnis (Self-Portrait)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a sketch of a person showing the upper half of their body, positioned in a frontal view with a slightly turned head. The person's facial features are detailed with a prominent mustache and closely cropped hair, showcasing a serious expression and defined features. The person is dressed in a simple, nondescript garment. There are no visible accessories or objects being held. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a uniform beige shade. The sketch is signed at the bottom right.

artworks.title: Kinderköpfe (Heads of Children)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Marcy Family in memory of Sigbert H. Marcy
artworks.description: Four sketches of children's faces are depicted on a blank background. The central sketch shows a child looking slightly leftward with wide eyes and straight hair. The upper left sketch shows a child looking slightly right with prominent eyes. Below this, another face is depicted looking downward with minimal details. In the bottom right, a smiling child with shoulder-length hair is shown, possibly wearing a bow. The sketches lack detailed clothing and are set against a plain background. Some scribbled text or a signature is visible near the bottom right corner.
